name: [⚔️UPDATE] Planetary Awakening (The Moon Woke Up)
desc:
🌙 The moon has woken up and is headed to Earth! Survive the cosmic threats, rebuild humanity and explore space!

🔨 Build colonies on other planets!
🚀 Explore space!
🪐 Survive the awakening of the moon and planets!
💵 Earn lots of cash!
⚔️ Fight the moonfected or become one!
